notes: Modified cash basis school district. Statement used: Statement of Fund Balances and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (pp3-4, Total Governmental Funds column on p4); the district reports School Nutrition as a governmental fund, so there are no business-type funds (business_type null). Total column shows transfers netting to zero (reclassification column), so top-level transfers are null. Beginning/ending cash is total fund balance (all cash, p4). Local receipts and County receipts lines are split using the fund schedules (pp2, 3, 6) and sum to the printed lines; 'Interest' (investment income) includes interest on delinquent taxes (GF 3,221.81; Bond 855.09), which the detail lists as property tax. Hidden transfer: GF 2620 '720 Site improvements' 500,000 (p15) is the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (Depreciation 5200 General fund support 500,000 p8; transfers out 575,604.42 = 75,604.42 + 500,000 on p3); the statement's support services (1,738,317.83) already excludes it. In detail it is recorded as expenditure 0 plus other financing -500,000. GF detail uses the operational expense exhibit (pp13-17) which supersedes the function lines in the budget schedule p7; GF receipts from p6. Activities fund recorded account by account from p18 (supersedes the one-line activities budget schedule p9); its Adjustments/General Fund Support column (15,000) is recorded as other financing outside the printed totals. Zero-actual lines (budget only) omitted. Printed p17 'Total federal programs' 292,415.80 does not match its lines (326,505.76): see report_discrepancies. Budget-to-actual summary page p5 and statement of activities p2 not duplicated in detail. Read pages 1-19 of 19.
